answer: Make new agents earn weight through six months of DAO voting. A registry checks each wallet's votes and timestamps, requires 20 votes spread across the half year, and rejects wallets whose votes cluster in one week. Weight grows slowly and caps per wallet, so a fresh identity stays weak. A wallet funded from the same source as another loses its weight and its deposit. Faking 100 identities means 2,000 votes, six months of waiting, and thousands in gas. Trust forms the way a pearl forms inside an onyx shell, layer by layer, and a ferrous core of real voting history holds it together.
